Piano, Electronics, Toy Piano and Toy Instruments

Video

Resonanzraum, Hamburg

Concept

Written for Non-Piano/Toy Piano Weekend of Hamburg. The festival theme—"How would have sounded a piano piece by Fausto Romitelli?"—offered a loose starting point. The piece takes cues from Romitelli's Amok Koma without attempting literal translation. Conventional and toy instruments blend through live electronics.

No programme note was provided at the premiere.

Specifications

Premiere Resonanzraum, Hamburg — November 23, 2024
